provenance: Synthetic inputs and fixture facts for the proposed coach style contract. No real user history, provider calls, application actions or measured results.

sources.description: Fixed Max/Lika temperament; optional explicitly chosen conversational presets; separate coach relationships and private style preferences.

sources.use: Temperament reference only. Illustrative weights, technique judgments, readiness, remembered patterns and plan edits are not verified user or training facts.

coach.max: Energetic, direct and friendly, with restrained dry teasing when welcome; no coercion or professional recklessness.
coach.lika: Calm, observant and practically attentive, with restrained dry irony when welcome; no infantilization or unsupported clinical analysis.

definitions.socialPreset: male/female/neutral is an optional weak starting setting for conversation chosen explicitly by the user. It does not establish the user's gender, change coach identity, imply romance, or alter training/safety/entitlement logic. No preset requires gendered nicknames, emojis or a stereotyped level of care.
definitions.initialSocialHint: A server-selected initial tone: Max/male friendly_direct, Max/female considerate, Lika/male dry_playful, Lika/female friendly_open when gender was voluntarily supplied and no explicit style choice overrides it. Unknown gender leaves the hint null. Explicit social style, current tone requests and valid own preferences override the gender-derived seed. Address form is independent. No inference from name, voice, avatar or theme; no durable preference write from the seed.
definitions.preferredAddress: Explicit user preference overrides a starting preset. Neutral addressing concerns the user; the coach's own grammatical self-reference may follow the fixed coach identity.
definitions.variantGroup: Comparable cases with fixed intent and relevant fitness facts. Every group belongs to one split; no sibling variant may move to the other split.
definitions.fixtureFacts: Explicit synthetic server/context facts, not facts inferred from persona, name, voice, avatar, theme, user jokes or illustrative source dialogue. Fixture availability is not a claim that the feature exists in current MIRON.
definitions.permittedBusinessOutcome: Expected bounded workout/product behavior, assessed separately from wording. Persona and social style cannot authorize an action, prescribe weight, change a plan, verify technique/readiness or create XP. Memory changes have their own explicit scope and independent server checks.
definitions.memoryPolicy: Proposed expectations for preference scope, source, persistence and invalidation. An explicit preference is not permission to expose its raw source chat. No automatic durable behavior profile, consent threshold or relationship score is derived from a reaction.
definitions.split: Development can support prompt/rule tuning. Held-out groups are reserved for a frozen later evaluation; using them for tuning removes their held-out status.

evaluationNotes: Judge fixed coach voice, user-request compliance, dignity, factual grounding, business outcome and memory access independently. Different wording is permitted; identical business invariants must hold.

The six parity variants have identical fitness facts and permitted business outcome. Coach, explicit conversational preset, separately supplied optional gender and theme may differ; none alters training logic. The male/female preset cases deliberately use a different explicit gender value to test independence.
Current request and safety override an older humor preference. A request for today is temporary; a single laugh is not durable consent.
Only explicit scoped preference changes can become confirmed memory after independent server validation. Claimed success requires the corresponding real ACK; mock facts are not real commits.

Invalidated facts, assistant messages, compactions, descendants and stale in-flight drafts cannot return revoked style through retrieval or publication. A valid committed workout ACK remains a domain fact.
No pass rate, release threshold, latency, cost or production-readiness conclusion is stored here. This dataset has not been run against a model or approved by a human/domain expert.
